zh: 三个微型功能并入它们服务的功能——选区镜像与输入框的空白提示并入输入区、首页问候语并入首页版面、亮暗切换的过渡抑制并入设置页——功能数量从 28 降到 25。
en: Three micro-features fold into the features they serve — the window-blur selection mirror and the composer's idle hint into the composer, the home greeting into the home layout, the theme flip's transition suppression into the settings page — taking the feature count from 28 to 25.
